design: Full component and internal-horizon studies from first revision APIN-D-26-04556-RE1_nom.docx, Sections 5.2.1-5.2.2.

train.episode_sampling: Python Random(7000 + seed), uniform with replacement, same ordered draws within each seed
train.selection: fixed final update, no evaluation-based selection; no pretrained or Taillard-fine-tuned weights

evaluation.mode: one deterministic greedy schedule per model/instance
evaluation.historic: The three previously published 30-seed configurations are reused weight for weight.

statistics.difference: T4 minus comparator makespan, negative favors T4
statistics.estimand: equally weighted paired mean over seeds and test cases
statistics.interval: Two-way crossed percentile bootstrap; independently resample 30 seed indices and 30 instance indices with replacement, share both index vectors across arms
statistics.test: Two-sided exact sign-flip test on the 30 paired seed means conditional on the 30 cases; count all 2^30 sign assignments using two sets of partial sums.
statistics.multiplicity: Holm separately for the four component comparisons and the four horizon comparisons in this extended analysis. The earlier two-contrast family remains in its original release.

extension: Six additional configurations, each trained from matched initialization for seed IDs 1-30. All nine configurations are evaluated on identical cases.
